project.description: The world's one ticker: how many ticks there are to a second, said once, and the tick, a count from the world's beginning that is part of its state. How long a tick is and how long the world has gone on are worked out from the count and never added up, and so is the calendar's moment, for a world that keeps a real place's hour. Depending on nothing, and reading no clock: whatever paces a world against a real clock is outside it, and says only how many ticks to take.
